lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots extending from the posterior branchial region to the caudal peduncle; spots exhibit a structured, semi-linear arrangement on the flank and a high-density, stochastic distribution on the cephalic region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows at approximately 90-degree angles, creating a rectilinear grid-like matrix across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal carinae are visible on the upper flank, each defined by a sharp vertical luminance transition (high-intensity light on the dorsal edge, low-intensity shadow on the ventral edge) extending horizontally towards the tail.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains approximately 12-15 distinct high-luminance blobs; the spatial frequency is highest in the anterior-basal region of the fin silhouette, with spots becoming sparser toward the posterior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of at least two elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (commensal organisms) attached to the ventral-lateral region posterior to the pectoral fin; the pectoral fin exhibits an extremely high-density constellation of high-luminance spots.
